round_6_star_fallback.note: Round-6 star-fallback discovery (2026-11-18): GitHub repository searches restricted to language:C and stars:>=100 (first 100 hits each, sorted by stars), plus the cell's earlier GitHub-only leads. stargazers_count, fork flag and tags were captured from the GitHub REST API (star_captures, with the response SHA-256). Most hits are servers, proxies, tunnels, scanners or test tools without a parser library API; the decisions list covers every DNS library candidate.
round_6_star_fallback.rule: PROTOCOL.md star fallback (2026-11-18): C/C++ slots left empty after primary-metric and Debian-fallback paths may be filled by pinned tagged releases of upstream, format-specific GitHub repositories with stargazers_count >= 100; ranked separately by stars; metric 'GitHub stars (secondary, repository interest, not downloads)'.

decisions.wahern/dns: selected (supplemental, stars 273): dns.c rel-20160808, DNS-specific single-file resolver library whose public packet API (struct dns_packet, dns_p_study, dns_rr_grep, dns_any_parse) decodes caller-supplied bytes; both controls match the oracle.
decisions.mjansson/mdns: excluded: mDNS/DNS-SD library whose message decoding runs only inside socket receive functions (mdns_query_recv, mdns_discovery_recv, mdns_socket_listen read with recvfrom); the public record helpers parse PTR, SRV, A, AAAA and TXT RDATA only (no MX), so there is no documented API for caller-supplied message bytes.
decisions.NLnetLabs/simdzone: excluded: zone-file parser (out of scope for the wire-format cell).
decisions.c-ares/c-ares: already selected by the primary metric (Debian popcon).
decisions.NLnetLabs/ldns: already selected by the primary metric (Debian popcon).
decisions.CZ-NIC/knot: already selected by the primary metric (mirror repository; Debian source knot).
decisions.NLnetLabs/unbound: excluded in round 1 (sldns parser internal; resolver API).
decisions.apple-oss-distributions/mDNSResponder: excluded: daemon with dns_sd.h service API (round 4); no message-bytes API.
decisions.troglobit/mdnsd: below the star threshold (75 stars) and response-control failure (MX RDATA not decoded).
decisions.robertdavidgraham/dnsparse: below the star threshold (24 stars) and no tagged release.
decisions.rofl0r/firedns: below the star threshold (18 stars) and no tagged release.
decisions.Pro/mdnsd: GitHub fork of mdnsd (fork: true) with 11 stars; not eligible.
